price_field_note: Travis Industries Fire Garden is an outdoor fire-systems catalog. The extractable text in this image-heavy PDF carries NO published dealer or retail prices. The Tempest Torch line is a feature catalog with no pricing in the text layer. The Voracious Fire Burner Custom Plate Kits are explicitly marked COST BY BID on every order form (price set per quote/bid, not list). dealer_price and msrp are left null for all models; pricing must be obtained via Travis sales bid (800-654-1177). Documented fees: $100 cancellation fee for plate-kit orders cancelled after 48 hours, plus an oversize fee when burner width or depth exceeds 47-3/4 inches.
